headline: Browser-gate truth now names the commit it proves.

items.title: CI beacon source-head attestation
items.insight: The public CI beacon now records the exact browser-gate commit it verified. That makes green release claims easier to audit without digging through Action history.

items.title: S270 post-push browser gates confirmed
items.insight: The S270 route-tier Lighthouse workflow is proven green on the pushed commit. Worker deploy remains separately known-blocked, so the site avoids mixing a provider token issue with browser release quality.
items.evidence: gh run list; api/ci-status.json browserGatesGreen true

items.title: Evidence-gated Lighthouse work no longer ranks as NOW
items.insight: The Genius List now treats a stricter Lighthouse target as gated until a trace-backed pass exists. That keeps agents from force-shipping a cosmetic status change when the right move is a focused performance investigation.

items.title: Task-board rotation warning cleared
items.insight: Four old session blocks moved into the archive through the existing rotation tool. The live board is smaller and the closeout warning is gone without deleting history.

followUps: Repair CF_WORKER_API_TOKEN R2 Bucket Read/Edit scope for vaultspark-rum.
Run a focused CLS/performance pass for /oracle/ and /membership/ before revisiting homepage Lighthouse 0.85.
Add a generator self-test fixture for evidence-gated Lighthouse phrasing.
blockers: Worker deploy remains provider-token-scope gated on Cloudflare R2 Bucket Read/Edit.

honestyLedger.title: Homepage Lighthouse 0.85 not claimed
honestyLedger.why: Local traces show fast homepage LCP, but no focused trace-backed 0.85 Lighthouse pass was produced.

honestyLedger.title: Worker deploy not force-greened
honestyLedger.why: The red remains a known provider token-scope blocker, not a local code failure.

honestyLedger.title: CLS findings deferred honestly
honestyLedger.why: measure-page-performance surfaced /oracle/ and /membership/ CLS overages that need their own focused pass.

amortization.verdict: Useful structural closeout: source-head proof and gating cleanup reduce future rework.
